# Resilient by design: The agentic supply chain

## As global supply chain complexity grows, agentic AI may offer manufacturers transformative ways to manage risk and capture new value

By Tim Gaus,  Lane Warshaw,  Lindsey Berckman,  Kate Hardin,  John Morehouse,  Pete Robertson

### Tim Gaus

Principal | Smart manufacturing business leader | Deloitte Consulting LLP

United States

Tim Gaus is a principal and the smart manufacturing business leader with Deloitte Consulting LLP. He brings over 25 years of supply chain experience with a focus on value chain optimization using emerging technology. He has led multiple supply chain transformations, spanning supply chain strategy, manufacturing optimization, supply chain planning, inventory optimization, operating model design, and operational excellence for domestic and multinational corporations.

[*tgaus@deloitte.com*](mailto:tgaus@deloitte.com "mail")

### Lane Warshaw

Managing director | Deloitte’s Artificial Intelligence & Data Engineering

United States

Lane Warshaw, PhD, is a Managing Director in Deloitte's Artificial Intelligence & Data Engineering (AI&DE) practice, where he serves as the intersection lead for AI & Data and Industrial Products & Construction. In this role, he shapes go-to-market strategy and helps industrial clients unlock measurable value from AI — across operational efficiency, customer experience, and enterprise capability.

With more than 30 years of experience, Dr. Warshaw specializes in large-scale data modernization, advanced analytics, and AI transformation across supply chain, finance, and customer domains. He has guided dozens of organizations through the full arc of AI  and agentic adoption — from strategy through deployment — designing and delivering some of the most complex modern data, AI, and agentic architectures in the industry. His work spans leading cloud platforms, best-of-breed technologies, and Deloitte's strategic alliance ecosystem.

Dr. Warshaw is a published author and a frequent contributor to Deloitte thought leadership, including points of view and industry articles on the use and deployment of AI and data solutions.

Principal | Deloitte Consulting LLP

Lindsey Berckman leads Deloitte’s US Aerospace & Defense practice and is also a Smart Manufacturing leader in Deloitte’s industrial manufacturing sector, with more than 16 years of experience serving at the intersection of production, operations, and technology in Deloitte’s Consulting practice. With her broad range of experience in our aerospace and defense, industrials, and automotive sectors, Berckman helps our clients shape their digital transformation road maps, investing in solutions built for scale, focused on delivering value, and designed to transform legacy manufacturing processes through digital technologies and AI/cognitive insights.
